answer: The dune register is checked at draw time, jade lists the eligible set, and cedar seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 5 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
